text: Looking at relativedelta's handling of whole-number floats (months=1.0 / years=1.0 should behave like months=1 / years=1, while genuinely fractional values keep raising ValueError). Fix in progress, ETA ~10 min.
Investigating rrule with count=0 (should yield no occurrences and count() == 0). Fix in progress, ETA ~10 min.
Investigating the missing `RRULE:` prefix in str(rrule(...)). Fix in progress, ETA ~10 min.
Fixing the fuzzy parser treating a lone `p`/`a` in a URL as an AM/PM marker (should skip it and return hour 0 with the full leftover text). In progress, ETA ~10 min.
Fixing the IndexError from `parse('2017-07-17 06:15:', fuzzy=True)` (trailing colon should just be skipped). In progress, ETA ~10 min.
Fixing `relativedelta.__add__` dropping absolute values explicitly set to 0 (day=0, hour=0). In progress, ETA ~10 min.
